summary: A schedule change for the May 1971 Network Working Group meeting. Dr. Roberts could not attend Monday afternoon, so the network planning and other ARPA projects topics move to Tuesday evening. It also corrects the reading list for Wednesday evening.

plainLanguage.summary: The meeting plan changed because an important guest could not come at the first time, so two topics moved to a different day.

subtitle: A schedule change for the May 1971 Network Working Group meeting.

tldr.problem: Dr. Roberts was unlikely to attend the Monday afternoon session of the NWG meeting.
tldr.mechanism: The topics Network Planning and other ARPA Projects move to Tuesday evening, and Monday afternoon takes up as many of the Tuesday evening items as possible.
tldr.outcome: The note also corrects the Wednesday evening reading to RFC 131 instead of RFC 113.

sections.title: The Schedule Swap
sections.content:
Crocker of UCLA reports that Dr. Roberts is unlikely to be able to attend the Monday afternoon session of the NWG meeting, but can attend the Tuesday evening session. The topics Network Planning and other ARPA Projects therefore move to Tuesday evening.

On Monday afternoon the group will take up as many of the items originally scheduled for Tuesday evening as it can.
sections.plainLanguage: Because the special guest can only come Tuesday evening, the topics he cares about move there, and Monday gets Tuesday's leftovers.

sections.title: Reading Correction
sections.content:
The relevant reading for Wednesday evening is RFC 131, not RFC 113. In general, the note says attendees should read all of the RFCs issued since the last NWG meeting.

The RFC updates RFC 140.
sections.plainLanguage: There was a typo on the homework list, so it is fixed. Everyone should read the new notes before the meeting.

sections.title: Why It Matters
sections.content: This is a housekeeping note with no protocol content. It shows how the Network Working Group coordinated its in-person meetings in 1971 and used RFCs to announce changes.
sections.plainLanguage: It is a notice on the board saying the plan changed, nothing more.

references.text: The reading for Wednesday evening, RFC 131.
